description: LPDDR mode-register field inventory for identifying the DRAM vendor, revision, density and topology. Register meaning is generation-dependent.

register_fields.notes: LPDDR manufacturer ID; decode with the matching generation's JEP166 table.
First revision-ID byte in coreboot memory-chip record.
Second revision-ID byte in coreboot memory-chip record.
Coreboot documents decoding density_mbits and io_width from MR8. Example MR8 0x10 -> 8192 Mbit, x16. Decode bit fields per the exact JEDEC generation/revision.
Eight-byte serial ID field recorded by coreboot; not a public part number.
These registers appear in MediaTek EMIInfoV12 schema. MR5 is annotated as vendor ID; remaining semantics must be decoded per JEDEC specification.

warnings: Do not reuse MR8 bit interpretations across LPDDR generations without checking the applicable JEDEC specification.
MR5 identifies the wafer manufacturer, not necessarily the brand printed on a packaged module.
Revision IDs and serial IDs are device-reported values, not guaranteed to map to a commercial ordering part number.
